tasks.title: Publish and review foundational roadmap and project governance
acceptance: Foundational roadmap is reviewed and merged to main
Maintainer roles and contributing/security guidance are accepted

tasks.title: Establish repository-native task registry and automated lifecycle validation
acceptance: Machine-readable task registry exists in canonical repository
CI validates task records and dependencies
Changes undergo PR review

tasks.title: Recover legacy Foromni repositories and issues without altering history
acceptance: Legacy projects and issues inventoried with source links
Reusable implementations and ownership identified
Migration decisions recorded without claiming unverified completion

tasks.title: Approve minimum privacy and trust model for discovery MVP
acceptance: Public/private fields and server-side access rules defined
Threat model and ownership decisions reviewed
Acceptance test cases specified

tasks.title: Implement pilot profile and project discovery vertical slice
acceptance: Pilot users can create and manage permitted profiles
Visitors can discover published projects
Automated authorization and persistence tests pass

tasks.title: Demonstrate bounded cross-system capability exchange
acceptance: Two independent systems exchange scoped task with explicit authorization
Revocation and audit behavior independently tested
No production secrets or privileged IE data are shared

tasks.title: Freeze minimal AINO execution-MVP contract and acceptance requirements
acceptance: Review and version-pin Member, Agent, Task, Lease, Sandbox, Attempt, Candidate, Evidence and Decision contracts
Independent reviewer records approved behavior, exclusions and exact source revision
Release/production rights remain separate from candidate acceptance

evidence.note: Document authored and versioned; not independent acceptance, tests or implementation

tasks.title: Qualify one disposable sandbox runner against required safety boundaries
acceptance: Select version-pinned Bubblewrap or NsJail runner with license/dependency review and exact host profile
Independent reviewer observes all mandatory filesystem, network, socket, process, syscall and resource denial tests
No untrusted code execution until isolation gates pass; unsupported controls fail closed

tasks.title: Build minimal persistent agent, task and attempt registry
acceptance: Create and query persistent task, stable agent identity, incarnation and bounded attempts
Task ownership and permissions are enforced by a trusted principal, not agent-provided IDs
Persistence, restart behavior, project scope and stale lease handling independently tested

tasks.title: Execute first bounded AI coding worker and export patch-only candidate
acceptance: One approved coding worker completes a synthetic task using a scoped task lease and tested runner
Only a diff/patch and untrusted worker logs leave the worker boundary
Record model/tool/runtime/retry/human costs and block unauthorized GitHub write or production access

tasks.title: Build separately authenticated source observer and independent QA evaluator
acceptance: Source observer independently reconstructs clean candidate SHA from frozen base and worker patch
Evaluator has separately controlled test suite, fixture store and execution identity
Correct candidate can pass; wrong, stale, forged PASS and zero-test candidates cannot pass

tasks.title: Persist source-bound evidence, status history and complete attempt economics
acceptance: Persist task revision, assignment, attempt, observed source SHA, evaluator result and reason tags
Track all attempts, time, model/runner/QA/human costs and missing cost completeness explicitly
Independent source evidence never conflates candidate, integrated, released and beneficiary outcomes

tasks.title: Provide founder/operator task intake and acceptance control
acceptance: Human can create and assign a task, inspect verified evidence, request repair or reject/accept
Agent cannot self-approve independent QA, integration, release or policy escalation
Workflow usable through minimal CLI or interface with authenticated audit history

tasks.title: Independently validate end-to-end founder AINO vertical slice
acceptance: Demonstrate task creation → assignment → isolated worker → reconstructed patch → real QA → human decision → persistent history
Repeat positive and negative cases including credential denial, stale source, interrupted attempt and forged PASS
Independent reviewer records exact checked source, limitations, failed cases and full-cost denominator

tasks.title: Prepare release-ready founder AINO execution MVP
acceptance: Document reproducible clean setup, security boundaries, operator use, rollback and known limitations
Independent acceptance tied to exact integrated candidate source; protected branch/merge controls independently verified
Founder separately authorizes release; no assumption that a passing local candidate has shipped

tasks.title: Enable first portable external open-source contribution pilot
acceptance: External contributor can submit patch from own compute without gaining Foromni trusted GitHub or QA rights
A maintainer reconstructs and independently evaluates exact source with permission and license provenance
Document asynchronous participation, tenant isolation, moderation and contribution policy with privacy-safe records
